comment: VERYYY good explainer but unfair tests.
She's nice and explains concepts well. The exams are manageable, and homework is just readings. I would definitely recommend her class to understand concepts without it being too difficult.

Dr. Erickson was a great professor and was always willing to answer questions or clarify material when it was clear the class didn't understand. She posts practice exams as study material as well as a study guide with topics and terms that the exam will cover. Exams can be tricky but review class slides and do the practice exam you'll be fine.

She makes her lectures very easy to understand. I love the way she teaches. She is very understanding. Her tests are extremely, extremely difficult. Study the material as much as you can because she actively tries to trick you on exams. Quizzes are a little easier. Very information-heavy, and labs are sometimes grueling. The dept. do it on purpose.
Dr Erickson is an outstanding professor. Her lectures are clear, and she incorporates many activities to reinforce the concepts throughout the year.

Took genetics of biodiversity and it was a very good class. Got tons of experience analyzing research papers, which is very helpful with other classes. Class had of problem sets with opportunities for revision as well as papers based on a scientific article of your choice. Dr. Erickson is very nice and accessible for office hours. Recommend it!

Dr. Erickson is a passionate professor, but ecology in general is relatively basic, and at times she struggled to make class seem unlike a middle school biology class. Bio202 is also very data oriented, so make sure you are prepared to use excel and others, but she's good at helping you navigate online. Overall, easy teacher, but class often boring

Genetics of Biodiversity was one of the most interesting and practical electives I've taken in biology, and Dr. Erickson is the best professor I've had at any point in college. She is a truly kind and encouraging person. Her feedback on papers/assignments is incredibly thorough, and it is evident that she cares very deeply about her students.

Dr. Erickson is the best biology professor I have had at U of R. This class was Genetics of Biodiversity and I am so glad I took it. We were taught how to read scientific papers as well as critique them and understand their scientific methods. I would highly recommend this course and Dr. Erickson as a professor.

Dr. Erikson's class was not difficult however it was difficult for her to be accommodating and understanding to various students circumstances. If you know you won't need to ask her for anything it is an easy A

Dr. Erickson was wonderful for bio 202!! There is a lot of assignments but many had a clear connection and were helpful. We practiced scientific writing a lot, which was extremely helpful! She grades very fair and if you put in the work you will be fine! Tests are only worth 35% of your grade including the final and emphasis is put on application!
The curriculum is trash, but Professor listened to students concerns and made sure to address them. Her explanations were also really helpful for understanding lectures. Overall pretty good

I had Dr. Erickson for Biology 200 Lab. Although I wasn't a huge fan of the lab curriculum, Dr. Erickson made it much more bearable. Her lectures were very helpful in explaining concepts and was very helpful when answering questions. She was very fair in grading the lab assignments. I'd highly recommend Dr. Erickson, she was fantastic!
